policy: Keep unqualified named characters and generic troop roles at the narrowest defensible family level. Physical differences in armor era, skin color, face color, sculpt print, pauldron rank, and accessory bracket remain unresolved unless the source key contains matching state evidence. Post-game redesigns are excluded.

systemic_findings: Troop-role identities need rank-state evidence before a pauldron color or command level can be selected.
Small decoration differences on big figures and creature molds remain exact-version ambiguity even when the semantic identity is obvious.
Armor-era and skin-color revisions should be modeled as physical generations rather than separate characters.
